A registry that does not list all files under the normalized project name does not follow the standard simple API, so the root cause sits in the index rather than in uv. Not verified: the screenshots were not readable from the text, and no search result showed a uv-side cause.

escalation_reason: Torn between bug (the report is filed as uv add failing) and likely_external (the index appears to list the files under a different project name). The screenshots that carry the evidence were not readable from the text.
rationale: The reporter's template says bug and the report describes uv add failing on markupsafe for cpython 3.12. The reporter's own evidence points to the PyTorch ROCm nightly index listing older markupsafe wheels under a different name (lowercased after 3.0.2), which is a non-standard registry behaviour rather than a uv defect; uv normalises project names, so the case change alone should not hide files. Search found no earlier issue with the same root cause (markupsafe searches returned unrelated hits), and the closest related issues (16685, 10693) are PyTorch index problems. A docs search on index version resolution returned no page that settles it. The post lacks the command and error text in readable form, so a maintainer would need a reproduction. Confidence is low because the screenshots could not be read and the type call is contested.
